Alger, 8 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 8, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — TECNO Algeria highlights the exceptional battery life of its new smartphone, the POVA Curve 2 5G, thanks to its massive 8000 mAh battery.
La marque TECNO Algérie a annoncé la dis: The brand TECNO Algeria has announced the availability of its new smartphone, the POVA Curve 2 5G. The main selling point of this model lies in its 8000 mAh capacity battery, designed to offer prolonged battery life to users. TECNO emphasizes the fact of no longer having to worry about recharging or carrying an external power bank, thus promising "freedom" of use. The smartphone aims to meet the needs of users looking for maximum endurance for their mobile devices. The press release highlights the importance of this battery capacity for a constraint-free user experience, thereby eliminating the "anxiety" related to the rapid discharge of the phone. The POVA Curve 2 5G is therefore positioned as a solution for those who prioritize battery life.
